name: light_lamp_pool
kind: light texture (PointLight2D), a standing lamp's pool (tutorial rooms)
centre_note: the pool's centre, px-edge coordinates from the top-left = the texture centre (PointLight2D centres its texture on the node); put the light on the lamp's shade
scale_note: the old lamp_pool.tres (256 px gradient) at texture_scale 1.3 reached 5.2 u. For the same reach this 192 px texture needs 4.33 art px per texture px; the whole-number art scale is 4 (radius 4.8 u) = texture_scale 1.6 in world px (1 u = 32 world px = 80 art px). Scale 3 (texture_scale 1.2) keeps the pool inside a small room; scale 2 (0.8) is a small lamp. The brief allows whole-number scales only for light textures.
filter: nearest (project default_texture_filter 0), so the bands stay hard
energy_note: the brightest band is #bab4aa (0.71); the old gradient peaked at white, so the core is dimmer than before at the same energy. ~1.4 gives the old peak (for Beti / the Godot session).
design: option B 'shade disc' (critic pick): a wide hot core (the shade's open bottom) with drifting edges, a 2nd band that swells to ~13 px and pinches to ~3 px on opposite sides, bands 3 and 4 2-4 px off-centre in different directions, an uneven dim spill (~10-30 px)
